svg.title: Purple stopwatch achievement badge
svg.desc: A softly rounded purple hexagon scales from the center. A gold stopwatch assembles, the cyan and violet hands spin, and smooth cyan arrows sweep into place. Subtle continuous confetti, twinkling stars, and violet rays accompany the gentle idle motion. Transparent vector artwork; matching WAV audio supplied separately.

g.aria-label: Gold rays, colorful confetti, and sparkling stars
